title: Claude Fable 5 prompt leak reveals detailed AI control #claudefable #promptleak #aitechnology
description: Claude Fable 5 system prompts leaked, revealing over 120,000 characters of precise instructions used by Endropic to guide their advanced AI model's reasoning and planning. These prompts can be adapted to enhance the performance of more affordable open-source models like GLM 5.2 and Kimi K3, effectively transferring high-level AI capabilities across platforms. This leak highlights a significant opportunity in AI development, showcasing how detailed prompt engineering can unlock greater potential in less complex models. It reflects a broader trend in AI where the quality of input—such as system-level prompts—can dramatically influence output quality and application effectiveness. By leveraging these instructions, developers and researchers can accelerate innovation and improve results without relying solely on costly proprietary models. This could reshape competitive dynamics in AI deployment and experimentation. #ClaudeFable5 #Endropic #AIPrompts #GLM52 #KimiK3 #AIDevelopment #PromptEngineering #OpenSourceAI #ArtificialIntelligence #AILeak #MachineLearning #AIModels #AIInnovation #TechLeaks #AITools
